paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness 诊断插件：把 home、进程、端口、大 session、版本问题收成一份可粘贴的报告。不替代 Desktop / TUI。
DeepSeek Harness diagnostic plugin: collect home, leftover processes, ports, oversized sessions, and
version problems into one paste-ready report. It does not replace Desktop / TUI.
This is a **bundle**, not a profile. Install it into an existing `web` / `tui` / custom profile. The
re is no doctor profile and no third chat UI.
After npm publish the install command becomes `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-doctor`.
Restart the profile after install. If `dump-config` has no doctor row, the manifest failed — do not

Host log on boot must include `doctor loaded`.
Then run `/doctor`. Reports are written to `$DSH_HOME/logs/doctor-<timestamp>.md` and `.json`.
